verdict.rationale: W&B documents an official MCP Server that gives an IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to W&B data, including Weave traces and evaluations. The Weave site says coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave through it, and a probe confirms the official wandb-mcp-server repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting via the server, and detailed documentation of the Weave-specific tool surface and setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave.
connects AI assistants to your Weights & Biases data and documentation so they can answer natural-language questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/wandb/wandb-mcp-server
